about: Small real RNA-seq examples: yeast reads with a yeast chromosome for HISAT2, and the gene counts of the airway experiment for DESeq2 and edgeR. Taken from the test data of the genomics-wasm project (github.com/comparativechrono/genomics-wasm, commit 0e5df1fba226dbfd606f719600336aeeccbe754a: datasets/rna-yeast and datasets/deseq2-airway, where rna-manifest.json and deseq2-manifest.json record every source and step).

yeast.organism: Saccharomyces cerevisiae (S288C reference genome R64-1-1, Ensembl)

reads.publication: Wu et al. (2018) Molecular Cell, doi:10.1016/j.molcel.2018.10.018
reads.source: nf-core/test-datasets, commit cad884e7fbe5617dcd55bdd07d9ddf65b54febe4 (testdata/GSE110004/SRR6357070_1.fastq.gz and _2.fastq.gz: 50,000 pairs that nf-core selected for chromosome I)
reads.selection: 256 complete pairs with unique alignments on chromosome I (in nf-core's STAR alignments): the first 128 names, in alphabetical order, of pairs with a splice that matches an annotated intron, and the first 128 of the others. The FASTQ records are copied unchanged, in their original order.

yeast.reference: nf-core/test-datasets reference/genome.fa (chromosome I, 230,218 bases), unchanged; the index (.fai) made for the workbench
yeast.annotation: nf-core/test-datasets reference/genes.gtf (Ensembl), without its one test line on a sequence named not_in_genome
yeast.spliceSites: the 5 introns between consecutive exons of the same transcript in that annotation, in HISAT2's format (0-based last base of the left exon, 0-based first base of the right exon)
yeast.licence: nf-core/test-datasets: MIT licence (see NOTICE.txt). The reads are public INSDC data (ENA/SRA).

airway.experiment: RNA-seq of airway smooth muscle cells: four cell lines, each untreated and treated with 1 µM dexamethasone for 18 hours
airway.publication: Himes BE et al. (2014) RNA-Seq transcriptome profiling identifies CRISPLD2 as a glucocorticoid responsive gene that modulates cytokine function in airway smooth muscle cells. PLoS ONE 9(6): e99625, doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0099625
airway.source: Bioconductor data package airway 1.26.0 (Bioconductor 3.20; the counts assay of its RangedSummarizedExperiment: reads counted per gene of Ensembl release 75, GRCh37)
airway.counts: integer read counts, unchanged: 63,677 genes (rows, Ensembl gene IDs) × 8 samples (columns, SRA run IDs), in the package's order
airway.samples: the package's sample table, with sample_id first: cell (cell line), dex (untrt/trt), albut (all untrt), Run, avgLength, Experiment, Sample, BioSample
airway.licence: LGPL (the package names no version; see NOTICE.txt)
